data.content_ref: inline:SRC_011's case-calibrated attack-edge construction reduces to SRC_008's admissible enrichment: the library of committed runs and per-case-family calibration of build_att is exactly a policy for choosing one admissible enrichment among many, and the validity guarantee is a corollary of SRC_008's 'no new accepted attacker on a root' check. The causal mechanism is shared — both are pure, deterministic, polynomial monotone functions on the non-committed-root subgraph; the case library selects which enrichment, never the fixpoint. REFUTED IF a case family in SRC_011 requires adding an edge incident to a committed root (outside SRC_008's allowed enrichment domain), or if two anchors in the library force conflicting edge constructions on the same graph so the enrichment is not a pure function.
